capture_rule: Capture the complete NIST TRC ThermoML JSON and landing record for DOI 10.1016/j.jct.2011.10.025 byte-for-byte. Retain every directly reported experimental binary and ternary vapor-liquid coexistence dataset and every point in source order, including complete compound, component-count, phase, temperature, pressure, liquid composition, vapor composition, uncertainty, method and provenance records. Preserve all companion pure-component, refractive-index and other source datasets. Do not select a system, phase, tie line, azeotropic or non-azeotropic region, favorable row or diagram segment. Do not use Wilson, Margules, NRTL, UNIQUAC, UNIFAC, extended Redlich-Kister, correlated, predicted or model-calculated values as measurements or derivation inputs.

allowed_before_target_release: admitted foundational, exact-arithmetic, finite-support, composition and equilibrium claims
admitted activity, fugacity-equivalent, phase-rule and THERMO-001 through THERMO-012 claims
source identity, DOI, dataset and row ordinals
forbidden_before_target_release: phase identity, uncertainty or tie-line outcome
lever rule, tie-line equation, Gibbs triangle or convex-hull construction
equation of state, continuum phase diagram, interpolation, regression or fitted interaction parameter
selected system, dataset, phase, row, interval or target-derived correction
